# PVInstance

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`
- **Abstract**: it cannot be created; other classes inherit from it

The base class of everything that has a position and an orientation in the world: `BasePart`, `Model` and `Camera`. It adds a pivot, the point the object is moved and rotated about.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PivotOffset` | `CFrame` | — | read/write | Where the pivot is, relative to the object. The default, the identity, puts it at the object's center. Set it to a hinge edge and `PivotTo` rotates the object about that edge. |

## Methods

### `GetPivot(): CFrame`

Returns the object's pivot in world space.

### `PivotTo(target: CFrame)`

Moves the object so that its pivot is at `target`. A `Model` moves every part under it and keeps their arrangement; a `BasePart` or a `Camera` moves itself.
